messages:
leo: Kicking off a short thread for the rollout of 'route-orchestrator v1' — goals: tenant-level soft-pause, deterministic cohorts, region-stepped rollout, shadow A/B for quality vs cost, and a clear fallback + auto-reinstate. Quick alignment?
anya: +1. prefer explicit tenant lists (auditability) for the first wave: 8 enterprise tenants + 3 internal QA tenants. avoids noisy percent math.
kim: Telemetry gates proposal: P99 latency delta > 20% OR client-visible error +0.5% absolute OR tokens-per-response +35% (15m window) => PAUSE affected tenants. For burst protection require both 5m and 15m windows to exceed before paging.
ops-bot: alert-bot: created composite alert 'orchestrator-v1-composite' with thresholds: p99_delta_15m=20, err_abs_15m=0.5, tokens_resp_15m=35. Page when cohort_rps>0.7.
devops: Fallback choreography: immediate route-swap to pinned target `v2-stable` for affected tenants; set rollout=PAUSED. Auto-evaluate after 10m; if metrics stable for 8m auto-reinstate. Manual rollback window = 60m. Also exposing soft-pause API: POST /rollouts/{id}/pause?tenant={tenant_id}.
maria: Shadow A/B: mirror sampled requests (deterministic hash) to `v1-small` for 48h to collect quality delta (store diffs, redact PII). Shadow artifacts TTL = 21d. Do not include shadow traffic in production billing metrics.
leo: Playbook checklist to move to next region: - whitelist + internal QA smoke pass - shadow A/B >=48h with quality delta <2% - golden cohort stable 24h - soft-pause exercised by oncall + runbook signed off - baselines uploaded to config-store (30d window)
anya: config snippet (YAML) for flag service: ```yaml
flag: route_orchestrator_v1
cohorts:
  - name: internal_qa
    tenants: [redwood-int-1, redwood-int-2, redwood-int-3]
    pct: 0
  - name: enterprise_wave1
    tenants: [ent-101, ent-204, ent-309, ent-412, ent-503, ent-600, ent-701, ent-809]
regions: [us-west1, eu-west1, asia-east1]
fallback:
  mode: route_swap
  target: v2-stable
  auto_reinstate_after: 10m
  manual_rollback_window: 60m
soft_pause_endpoint: /rollouts/{id}/pause?tenant={tenant_id}
shadow: {target: v1-small, duration: 48h, redact: true, retention_days: 21}
```
kim: Also add a synthetic daily 1k prompt check and human sample review after the first 6h of canary. If synth-diff > threshold, hold rollout and trigger human review.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started -> us-west1, cohort=enterprise_wave1, rollout_id=roll-1888888888. Monitoring hooks attached: latency,error,tokens,quality. Samples stored -> s3://rollouts/orchestrator/1888888888/samples.jsonl
maria: Scheduling a dry-run tomorrow to exercise soft-pause and auto-reinstate flows. please ack when you've reviewed the runbook.
leo: Acked.
anya: Acked.
kim: Acked.
